description: Place a conversational voice-AI phone call to a business on a consumer's behalf; give a plain-language objective and it navigates the call, extracting the answer. Business-directed (B2B), far less restricted than calling consumers — but the compliance gate still enforces recording consent per jurisdiction. [$0.2/per_call] [async→get_outcome]

business_phone.description: Business phone in E.164 (e.g. +14045550123). Provide this OR smb_id.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for compliance + recording-consent routing.

extract_fields.description: Structured fields to pull from the answer, e.g.…

idempotency_key.description: Retry key: a 24h replay returns the original receipt, not re-run or charged.

objective.description: What the call should accomplish, in plain language.

on_behalf_of.description: Name of the consumer the call is placed for.

smb_id.description: Known SMB identifier with a phone on record. Provide this OR business_phone.

name: call_business
